text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in us-east-1 (gateway-proxy). Error rate 5xx > 10% over 5m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/4981234567
Samantha Chen: paging raj — can you take first look? sounds like gateway-side issues, seeing customer errors in logs. @Raj Patel
Raj Patel: on it. first glance: large spike in connection_pool_error and grpc deadline_exceeded from backend pool A. correlates with connection_count reaching configured max (128). suspect connpool exhaustion + slow backend replies.
Marta Lopez: seeing same in logs — backend pods in us-east are healthy but latency for p99 has jumped to ~1.2s which bumps connection hold time. connpool max is hit.
Raj Patel: ok plan: 1) open circuit-breaker for poolA to shed new requests 2) shift traffic for latency-sensitive routes to us-west2 via traffic-steer 3) try quick increase of pool size as fallback. Doing action 1 now.
oncall-rotation: FYI taking pager for next 30m while Raj ramps mitigations.
Raj Patel: enabling circuit-breaker policy: 
```json
{"filter": "pool==A", "action": "fail-fast", "threshold": 0.1}
```
Raj Patel: circuit-breaker applied, start seeing request drop for problematic backend, errors spike down at the proxy but overall 5xx still ~8%.
Marta Lopez: attempting traffic steer for /v1/generate to us-west2 canary, executing route update.
Marta Lopez: command: 
```bash
redwood route update --service gateway-proxy --route "/v1/generate" --weight us-west2=30,us-east1=70
```
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: route-update-4981234567 (CI pass).
Marta Lopez: route update applied. metrics: us-west2 is picking up extra traffic, us-east p99 latency starting to drop.
Support Eng: Support reporting a small set of customers (org-084, org-211) had calls fail; are we blocking anything that would affect other regions?
Raj Patel: not at global level — only pool A in us-east had CB. non-vital routes still routed to us-east. overall customer impact estimated ~2% of requests, mostly short-lived jobs. We'll prepare status page note.
Samantha Chen: can we temporarily increase pool size while we investigate root cause? I can try a config bump but we should be cautious about cascading load.
Marta Lopez: tried to scale pool but hitting an older config flag — connpool implementation in this cluster uses a deprecated semaphore allocator, increment API blocked. getting error: 
```
ERROR: failed to update connpool config: allocator: deprecated-semaphore locked
```
Marta Lopez: suspect recent platform patch removed hot-reload for allocator. Need a rolling deploy of gateway-proxy to pick up new allocator flag.
Raj Patel: rolling deploy will take ~8-12 min per AZ. prefer traffic-steer + circuit-breaker while we plan the deploy. can we add a short-term lambda fallback in front to queue spikes?
Samantha Chen: yes we have a fallback route that fans to the local prefix cache. Enabling it for heavy clients only. Doing a scoped rule for org-084/org-211 to redirect to cache-fallback.
Samantha Chen: command: 
```bash
redwood route patch --service gateway-proxy --match-org org-084,org-211 --target cache-fallback
```
ops-bot: route patch applied: patch-4981234567-org-scope.
Support Eng: customer comms draft: "We are aware of elevated errors affecting a small percentage of requests in US East. Engineers have applied mitigations including traffic steering and circuit breakers; affected customers may see intermittent failures. We will provide updates in 30 minutes." Approve? :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: approve. post it to status page and #general-ops.
Samantha Chen: posted status update to status.redwood.com/incidents/4981234567 and notified account teams.
Marta Lopez: monitoring — us-east 5xx now down to ~3.5% and trending down. p99 latency for pool A down from 1.2s to 0.45s. connpool usage back under 70%.
Raj Patel: good. next steps: schedule rolling deploy of gateway-proxy to fix allocator (will coordinate with eng-runtime). start canary in one AZ after 30m of stable metrics.
oncall-rotation: handing over to Marta for watch and deploy coordination. I'll be available if things regress.
Marta Lopez: taking over. starting deploy plan doc: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/4981234567-deploy-plan. ETA for canary roll: 40m.
Samantha Chen: note for postmortem — investigate why allocator hot-reload was removed and why connpool config blocked scaling. Also add a test that simulates p99-backed connection hold to validate circuit-breaker thresholds.
Support Eng: any need for escalation to SEV1? current impact small and mitigations hold. propose SEV2.
Raj Patel: SEV2 sounds right. tagging eng-runtime and infra on the postmortem.
Marta Lopez: metrics stable for 10m. I'll proceed with canary deploy in 5m and report back.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: gateway-proxy-v2-canary in us-east-az-a.
Marta Lopez: canary healthy so far. p99 stable. advancing to wider AZs.
Samantha Chen: thanks team. once deploy completes let's run a quick regression test (100 concurrent generate calls) against a small test org.
Marta Lopez: deploy finished. allocator replaced, connpool hot-reload restored, no errors on scale. manually bumped pool max to 256 for us-east.
Raj Patel: verifying metrics — final 5xx rate <1% for us-east. p99 latency back to normal ~120ms.
Samantha Chen: great. closing pager — will do postmortem and link runbook and timeline.
incident-bot: Incident 4981234567 marked: resolved by oncall (Marta Lopez). Summary: connpool exhaustion in us-east due to allocator hot-reload regression + p99 backend latency; mitigations: circuit-breaker, traffic steering, org-scoped fallback, rolling deploy to restore allocator and increase pool size.
Marta Lopez: I'll kick off postmortem and include action items (restore hot-reload test, adjust CB thresholds, increase default pool to 192, run chaos test for connpool).
Support Eng: thanks team. notifying impacted accounts with follow-up email.
Samantha Chen: handing back to oncall rotation. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
